title: Wayfare Rides Cancellation and No-Show Fee Table for On-Demand Trips
content:
The cancellation grace period, the cancellation fee, the no-show fee and the pickup-delay waiver threshold for **on-demand** trips of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** are set per ride option as follows.

| Figure | Wayfare Shared | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancellation grace after acceptance (minutes) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 5 | 5 |
| Cancellation fee | $4.00 | $5.00 | $5.00 | $7.50 | $7.50 | $10.00 | $15.00 |
| No-show fee | $4.00 | $5.00 | $5.00 | $7.50 | $7.50 | $10.00 | $15.00 |
| Pickup-delay waiver threshold (minutes beyond the original pickup estimate) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |

## Definitions

- **Cancellation grace after acceptance**: minutes after a driver accepts an on-demand trip during which the rider may cancel without a fee.
- **Cancellation fee**: fee for a rider cancellation of an on-demand trip after the grace period, USD.
- **No-show fee**: fee when the driver marks an on-demand rider as a no-show, USD.
- **Pickup-delay waiver threshold**: no cancellation fee if the rider cancels while the driver has not arrived and more than this many minutes have passed beyond the original pickup estimate.

## Notes

- On every ride option the cancellation fee and the no-show fee are the same figure.
- The pickup-delay waiver threshold is 5 minutes on every ride option; the grace period is 5 minutes on Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV and 2 minutes on the other ride options.
- Reserved trips carry their own late-cancellation and no-show fees under the Wayfare Reserve terms; the figures above are for on-demand trips.
